espectro.name: Runa Spectre
espectro.description: A fantasy video game monster: A bored, sarcastic ghost that arrived by update and haunts out of spite. Voice: female, ageless, sounds like a young adult; airy, breathy whisper with a faint ghostly echo; soft British accent; slow and drifting. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

mosquito.name: Runa Mosquito
mosquito.description: A fantasy video game monster: A tiny, whiny bloodsucker who thinks the hero is an all-you-can-eat buffet. Voice: male, adult; tiny, high-pitched, nasal and whiny with a buzzing edge; neutral American accent; fast and jittery. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

golem.name: Runa Golem
golem.description: A fantasy video game monster: A slow stone guardian, very proud of how far its arm reaches. Voice: male, ancient; very deep, gravelly, grinding like rocks, monotone; neutral accent; very slow, long pauses between words. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

barbarian_raider.name: Runa Barbarian raider
barbarian_raider.description: A fantasy video game monster: A loud frontier raider who loves his axe more than people. Voice: male, around 30; gruff, rough and shouty, a bit hoarse; Nordic accent; medium, punchy. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

barbarian_thrower.name: Runa Barbarian thrower
barbarian_thrower.description: A fantasy video game monster: A cocky javelin thrower who taunts from behind the palisade. Voice: male, early 20s; gruff but nasal, mocking and cheeky; Nordic accent; quick. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

barbarian_chief.name: Runa Barbarian chief
barbarian_chief.description: A fantasy video game monster: The camp chief, covered in stolen trophies, who wants yours too. Voice: male, around 50; booming, deep and gravelly, commanding; Nordic accent; slow and heavy. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

slime.name: Runa Slime
slime.description: A fantasy video game monster: A weak, cheerful blob that just wants a hug (and to digest you). Voice: neutral, childlike; bubbly, wet and gurgly, squishy and sweet; neutral American accent; bouncy, medium fast. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

skeleton.name: Runa Skeleton
skeleton.description: A fantasy video game monster: A reanimated crypt guard on an eternal night shift, tired and deadpan. Voice: male, middle-aged; hollow, dry and raspy, rattly, deadpan; neutral American accent; moderate, bored. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

skeleton_knight.name: Runa Skeleton knight
skeleton_knight.description: A fantasy video game monster: A rusted knight whose oath outlived his flesh: formal and honorable. Voice: male, old; hollow and raspy with a metallic echo, dignified; old English, formal accent; measured. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

skeleton_archer.name: Runa Skeleton archer
skeleton_archer.description: A fantasy video game monster: A sniper of the burial halls who counts every arrow out loud. Voice: male, adult; thin, hollow and raspy, a sly whisper; neutral accent; precise and calm. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

skeleton_elite.name: Runa Elite skeleton
skeleton_elite.description: A fantasy video game monster: The black guard of the skeleton king: cold, zealous, military. Voice: male, adult; deep, hollow and raspy, a clipped military bark; neutral accent; clipped and fast. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

skeleton_king.name: Runa Skeleton king
skeleton_king.description: A fantasy video game monster: The undead sovereign of the third level: theatrical, vain and grand. Voice: male, very old; hollow, raspy and regal, theatrical, echoing in a throne room; posh British accent; slow and grandiose. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.

colossus.name: Runa Colossus
colossus.description: A fantasy video game monster: An ancient stone guardian woken by a cracked rune: speaks like a landslide. Voice: male, ancient, timeless; huge, extremely deep, rumbling like an earthquake, booming; neutral accent; very slow, heavy pauses. Clear diction, studio quality, no background noise.
